facilityFacts.claim: The clubhouse occupies a former school; two preserved oaks stand between parking and course.
Official hotel site states 22 rooms, 48 beds, adjacent seasonal outdoor pool and free parking.
Restaurant has terrace with course/bay views.
Training facilities include driving range with some covered bays, putting green, two short-game areas and short course.
Outdoor padel is part of the club facility.
Tourism directions identify restaurant and golfshop in main building and hotel in smaller neighboring building; tourism room count of 16 is outdated against the official 22.
